protocol: 3-split: train on train.jsonl, select on val.jsonl, report on test.jsonl. Epsilon-constraint selection: (1) budget-paced Pareto AUC as primary metric, (2) non-stationary Phase-2 regret as secondary. All configs within 5% of best budget-paced AUC form the feasible set; among those, lowest Phase-2 regret wins.
